evidence.observation: Purge brought exhaust O2 down from about 28,800 ppm to 13 ppm; it has stayed at 3–7 ppm since.
Thermocouple tracked the ramp setpoint to within about 1 °C.
Brief overshoot to 760.6 °C at the start of growth, then settled at 749.8 °C against a 750 °C setpoint.
Heater power is steady at about 44% during the hold; the drop from about 80% on the ramp fits the end of ramping.
Argon flow is steady at about 100 sccm, matching the setpoint.

args.missing_evidence: No pressure gauge is installed, so an exhaust blockage can't be detected directly. No reference ranges were given, so the hold heater power can't be compared with normal runs. Post-run characterization is needed to judge growth.
